hypothesis: An episodic ridge solver with a meta-learned nonlinear pairwise feature map more accurately transfers local Boolean conditions than E35-B attention.
method: Differentiable polynomial feature embed + per-episode regularized least-squares solver; sequential edge->node using only self-predicted edge graph
training: 2048 existing known-law training histories; query next-state targets; no law IDs/formulas/teacher labels as features; only observed support labels at inference
comparison: E35-B and E22 known accuracy, E34 known and N39; N2-L3 and L4 H1/4/8/16 conditional on model passing initial known-law gate
gate: Must beat E35-B on all three seeds and E22 on at least two, not regress any known law > 6/80 vs E22; must match/improve E34 N39 pairs on >=2 seeds before considered an algorithmic baseline rival; additionally external sealed composition is mandatory for baseline promotion
evaluation: previously open splits only; N39 is historical open; never claim N40 promotion on these data
limitations: Single experimental architecture; no claims about novel-law sealed generalization without a new exam
